page.layout: One printed block: a boxed table in the left part of the page. At the top a head "Eleuatio poli." with a column heading "G."; below it a column of page numbers 67 to 90, in groups of three separated by rules.; One table of numbers in a single column with a bracketed heading at top, cut off at the left edge; the printed words are partly visible. Rows of numbers grouped by rules.; One page of a table, in two printed columns side by side, with a column of numbers at the left edge partly cut off; the right column is headed "Maximæ" / "titatis." and the left column "M."; the table has no text below and no margin notes.; One table of numbers in ruled columns: a header line at top with the title "diei quinq" in italic, then column heads "Ho." and "Mi.", then rows of numbers in two columns with rules between groups.
page.running_head: Eleuatio poli. / us zodiaci semi= / Maximæ
page.notes: The table is printed in a ruled box with a heavy vertical rule on each side. The numbers are in a bold italic display type. The heading "Eleuatio poli." is in italic and partly set in a larger face. The image is cut off at the right, so the rest of the table is not visible here. The heading words at the top are cut off at the left edge; only fragments "Arcu", "per" and "Gr" are visible, so they are given as far as legible. The numerals in the column are set in a decorative old-style face; the values are copied as printed. The numerals in the M. column are in old-style figures; 5 and 2 are sometimes hard to tell apart in the cut-off left column, which is not transcribed. The left edge is cut off, so the leftmost column is only partly visible and not transcribed. The printed watermark "http://rcin.org.pl" at the foot is a digitiser's link and is omitted. Roman numerals in the Ho. column are printed as shown (I, II, XVI etc. in old form); the figures are copied as printed. The header "diei quinq" is cut off at the right edge and is read as far as visible.
